definitions.gloss: muscular; well-built; having a muscular build
definitions.explanation: Describes a body type characterized by well-developed muscles and low body fat. Combines 筋肉 (muscle) with 質 (quality/nature), literally meaning "of a muscular nature."

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{筋肉質|きんにくしつ}な⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{水泳|すいえい}{選手|せんしゅ}→水泳選手：29200_suieisenshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{筋肉質|きんにくしつ}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
⟦トレーニング→トレーニング：00408_toreeningu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{以前|いぜん}→以前：01790_izen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{筋肉質|きんにくしつ}な⟦{体型|たいけい}→体型：16561_taikei⟧になった。
examples.english: As a result of continued training, I developed a more muscular physique than before.

notes:
USAGE:
{筋肉質|きんにくしつ} is a na-adjective describing a body type with well-defined muscles. It is neutral and descriptive, without the exaggerated connotations that "macho" or "buff" might carry in English.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {筋肉質|きんにくしつ}な⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧ (a muscular body)
- {筋肉質|きんにくしつ}な⟦{体型|たいけい}→体型：16561_taikei⟧ (a muscular build/physique)

SIMILAR WORDS:
マッチョ is a loanword from English/Spanish meaning "macho" or "muscular," often used casually and sometimes humorously. {筋肉質|きんにくしつ} is more neutral and clinical. ⟦がっしり→がっしり：19940_gasshiri⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ describes a sturdy, solidly built body but does not specifically emphasize muscles.
